motions.name: 轻踢换重 · 右
motions.reviewer: Codex: technical checks and rendered-frame visual review, 2026-11-02
motions.reviewNotes: 2026-11-02: Codex automated 60 Hz full-loop review and 120 Hz transition measurements on GTX 1050 Ti; 88/88 candidate transition tests passed, only the 20 explicitly retained directed connections were visually inspected on female and male characters (40 six-frame boards). No obvious flips, floor penetration or limb intersections in inspected frames. CMU subject 93 Charleston source step patterns; practice adaptation with cycle editing, symmetric smoothing, stabilized ankle, authored arm counter-swing and eight-count retiming. Four source cuts plus four mirrored variants. Technical and Codex visual review; not certification by a dance teacher, not New Jazz. Evidence: TestResults/CharlestonReview and Docs/CHARLESTON_REVIEW.md.
